`final class NodeHoverEvent<N extends Node>`<br/>
**Extends:** [`NodeEvent<N>`](/reference/events/nodeevent/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.event.impl.node` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [NodeHoverEvent.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/event/impl/node/NodeHoverEvent.java)

The event of `onHoverStart`, `onHover` and `onHoverEnd`, with the position of the pointer.

## Description

[`Node.onHoverStart`](/reference/nodes/node/#Node-event-onHoverStart) fires on the frame where the node becomes hovered, [`Node.onHover`](/reference/nodes/node/#Node-event-onHover) on every frame while it is hovered, and [`Node.onHoverEnd`](/reference/nodes/node/#Node-event-onHoverEnd) on the frame where it stops being hovered.

## Learn more

- [Hover and tooltips](/use/learn/interactivity/hover-and-tooltips/#react-when-the-pointer-enters-and-leaves)
